name: Icon
summary: Icon primitive rendered from a sprite.

a11y.apg: No role and no keyboard: every Icon carries aria-hidden="true". An icon is decorative by construction here — the name comes from the text beside it, or from the label of the control it sits in. An icon that must be announced is a control with a label, not an Icon.

props.name: name
props.description: The glyph id, resolved against the sprite as #i-<name>. A name with no glyph renders nothing visible and throws nothing — check it against the catalogue. It also takes the app's OWN drawing — a component that returns its <svg> and receives the Aurea class and size, inheriting the colour (currentColor) — for a glyph the set does not have, or the app's logo, with no sprite of its own. A drawing has no fill weight.

props.name: size
props.description: Token scale. It follows the text it sits next to.

props.name: spriteUrl
props.description: LOCAL override of where the glyphs come from. The normal way is to set it once on AureaProvider; this is for the rare page carrying two sprites.

props.name: weight
props.description: fill draws the filled shape of the glyph — the one the selected item uses (ADR-0053). An app's own glyph stays regular.
